title: Deploy cap: keep the site under Cloudflare's 20,000 files and untrack 2,725 old screenshots

chat.text: The deployed site is 381 files short of the free Cloudflare cap, and 2,725 screenshots (343 MB) are still tracked in git although new ones are now ignored. A Sonnet task mastermind adds an .assetsignore for the dev-only AI log (with a script that proves the count) and untracks the pictures from a dry-run manifest. Files stay on disk, history is unchanged, one commit undoes it.
